description: Latest AQI for a city from the World Air Quality Index Project station network. Accepts "city" or "city, country" (e.g. "Rome, Italy"). The matched station is checked against the requested place: a station that is not plausibly in it (the upstream resolves "Venice" to Dayton, Ohio) is never served; the call errors naming what it matched and listing candidates, and the response carries a place block stating requested vs matched. Every reading carries measured_at, station identity, data_age_hours and freshness. A reading older than 24h is never returned as current: a reporting station within 100 km is used (station_selection=fallback_fresher_station; skipped_stale_station says what was passed over) or the call errors naming the station and its age. Returns AQI value, dominant pollutant, individual pollutant readings (PM2.5, PM10, O3, NO2, SO2, CO), temperature/humidity/pressure, and station info.

city.description: City name, optionally qualified by country or region after a comma (e.g., "beijing", "los-angeles", "Rome, Italy", "Paris, Texas")

name: get_aqi_by_city
